==What is Lojban?==

{{Side box|style=width:300px;|text=<table>
<tr><td>'''nelci'''</td><td>x1 likes x2.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''patfu'''</td><td>x1 is a father of x2.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''mi nelci do'''</td><td>I like you.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''mi patfu do'''</td><td>I'm your father.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''do nelci ma'''</td><td>What do you like?</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''ma nelci mi'''</td><td>Who likes me?</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''do patfu ma'''&emsp;</td><td>Who are you a father of?</td></tr>
</table>}}

[[Image:yt-evarusar.png|240x134px|'''Beauty in the artifice''': an introduction to Lojban by [https://bitsfair.com/ Ewa]|link=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6kI__OTFn0o|thumb]]

Lojban is a carefully constructed spoken language. It has been developed since 1987 by a community of logic and language enthusiasts, building on work that began in the 1950s with the [https://www.loglan.org Loglan] language.

* Lojban's grammar is based on simple rules, and its linguistic features are inspired by predicate logic.
* Lojban has words called [[attitudinals]] which function similar to emoticons and emoji, expressing emotions and nuance. '''ue''' indicates surprise; '''ba'u''' admits you're exaggerating.
* You can be as vague or as detailed as you like. Tense (past, present, future) and number (singular, plural) are optional by default.
* Lojban is machine parsable: The syntactic structure of a sentence is unambiguous and can be checked with software.
* There is a community of speakers who continue to explore and expand Lojban's possibilities, writing, translating, and making music in it.

===Lojban means different things to different people===

* a new perspective on language
* a way to discipline your thinking
* a medium for socialization and art
* a domain for exploring the intersection of human language and software
* a test-bed for linguistic experimentation

What will Lojban mean for you?

== Who we are ==
[[File:cll-1.1.png|thumb|''The Complete Lojban Language'', published by LLG|link=https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_book.pdf]]

This wiki is hosted by the '''[[Logical Language Group]]''' (LLG), also known as '''la .lojbangirz.''' — a non-profit organization founded in 1987 to promote the scientific study of the relationships between language, thought and human culture. LLG is recognized as a 501(c)(3) educational and scientific charity. 

LLG and this web site are run entirely by volunteers, and hosting costs are covered by members and donors. See [[Logical Language Group]] for how to contact the organization, attend the annual meeting, become a member, or donate.

== Official publications ==
''The Complete Lojban Language'' (the "CLL"), by John Woldemar Cowan, is the official reference grammar, published by LLG and available in several formats:
* [https://www.amazon.com/dp/0966028325 hardcover]
* [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_book.pdf PDF] ([https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_cover.pdf cover])
* [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1.epub EPUB] and [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1.mobi MOBI] (for Kindle and other ebook readers)
* In HTML: [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/ one file per section], [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-chapter-chunks/ one file per chapter], [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-no-chunks/ one big file]

The CLL is is easiest to read once you already understand some Lojban. It does not teach vocabulary, style, or colloquial usage.

''What Is Lojban? (.i la lojban mo)'' by Nick Nicholas and John Woldemar Cowan, provides a tutorial approach to the language:
* [https://www.amazon.com/dp/0966028317 paperback]

Lojban usage has changed over time. Some of these changes have been described by the '''BPFK''' (''baupla fuzykamni'', or "Language Planning Committee"), which was formed in 2003, or the '''LFK''' (''la lojbau fuzykamni''), which succeeded the BPFK in 2018. One of the more significant shifts is in the usage of articles ("gadri") such as ''lo'' and ''le''.

* [[How to use xorlo|The xorlo reform]], approved by LLG in 2003 
* [[BPFK Section: gadri|BPFK on gadri]]

== Learning Lojban ==
These resources have been made by the Lojban community.

=== Courses and textbooks ===
* [https://lojban.io/courses/introduction Getting Started with Lojban]: A course with interactive exercises based on the older [[Lojban Wave Lessons|Wave Lessons]] by la klaku, la kribacr, la xalbo, and others
* [https://lojban.pw/en/books/learn-lojban/ Learn Lojban]: A course by la gleki
* [[Lojban For Beginners, The Book|Lojban for Beginners]]: An older course by Nick Nicholas and Robin Turner
* [[la karda]]: A fast-paced overview of the Lojban grammar by ldlework
* [[pronunciation|Pronunciation guides]]

=== Dictionaries ===
* [http://lensisku.lojban.org/ la lensisku]: A collaborative online multilingual Lojban dictionary
* [https://la-lojban.github.io/sutysisku/lojban/index.html#&bangu=en la sutysisku]: A multilingual dictionary that also works offline and includes a searchable database of sentences
* [https://vlasisku.lojban.org/ la vlasisku]: An elegant Lojban-English dictionary, with attention to grammatical classification
* [https://guskant.github.io/lojbo/stardict.html StarDict dictionaries in several languages] (e.g. for [https://goldendict.org/ GoldenDict])
* [https://jbovlaste.lojban.org jbovlaste]: The original LLG-hosted collaborative dictionary database, now read-only. Many of the other dictionaries include its content.
* [[Word frequency lists|Word lists ordered by frequency of use]] and an unofficial [[Simple gismu|list of simple gismu definitions]].
* [https://guskant.github.io/lojbo/gismu-cmavo.html multilingual gismu and cmavo word lists] in TSV and HTML

=== Reading practice ===
* [[la .teris. po'u lo tirxu cu vitke zi'o le barda tcadu|Terry the Tiger]]: Short and easy, with audio
* [https://lynn.github.io/la-melbi-e-le-ractu/ la melbi .e le ractu]: A story with includes high-frequency vocabulary by la lalxu
* [[le cmalu noltru|The Little Prince]] and [[lo selfri be la .alis. bei bu'u la selmacygu'e|Alice in Wonderland]]: Translated by la xorxes
* [https://selpahi.de/oz_plain.html The Wonderful Wizard of Oz]: Translated by la selpa'i
* [[te gerna la lojban|...and more]]

==Connect with the community==
[[Image:yt-ro lo maha datka.png|240x160px|«ro lo ma'a datka» and other Lojban songs by [[la guskant]]|link=https://vimeo.com/album/3152276|thumb]]
Lojban is spoken by a vibrant community, producing literature, music, and art, and discussing questions about language and thought. The web comic [https://www.xkcd.com/191/ xkcd] said that, if you spoke Lojban, you'd have to speak with Lojbanists. That may not be such a bad thing!

=== Chat ===

The Lojban community is active on several Discord servers, including 
"[https://discord.gg/BVm4EYR lojban]" and "[https://discord.com/dGP5A6Fpj7 roljbogu'e]".

Ask questions in '''#ckule''', talk in or about Lojban in '''#lojban''', speak only Lojban in '''#jbosnu''', and chat about anything else in '''#jboselbau'''. Answers usually arrive within hours, often within minutes.

An older chat, which includes history going back to 2016, bridges [https://t.me/joinchat/BLVsYz3hCF8mCAb6fzW1Rw Telegram] with IRC.

See [[Lojban Live Chat]] for other ways to connect.

=== Forums, social media and mailing lists ===
* [https://old.reddit.com/r/lojban/ r/lojban] on Reddit
* [https://www.facebook.com/groups/Lojban/ Lojban group] on Facebook
* [https://groups.google.com/g/lojban-beginners lojban-beginners] — questions about learning and understanding Lojban ([mailto:lojban-beginners@googlegroups.com subscribe])
* [https://groups.google.com/g/lojban lojban] — the general-purpose list, founded in 1989 ([mailto:lojban@googlegroups.com subscribe])
